builds.name: Infernum Moonlight Vigil cluster ceiling
builds.summary: Find a high-number candidate for Infernum Moonlight Vigil cluster in the specified finite setup; compare the competing stat package.
builds.goal: Find a high-number candidate for Infernum Moonlight Vigil cluster in the specified finite setup; compare the competing stat package.
builds.hypothesis: R3 starts225+0.2 bonusAD+1 AP physical, then weapon attacks. Infernum helper adds150+0.25 bonusAD and0.9 penalty; crit helper1+0.3*critChance*(critDamage-1). Splash overlap/classification needs measurement. IE75 AD/critDamage; Collector/Essence/LDR complete100% crit; Bloodthirster80 AD; LDR35% armor penetration/conditional bonusHP amplification; Shojin12% ability amplification candidate. Collector execute/Essence Spellblade separated unless real attack delivery verified.

Infernum main hand; five clustered3000HP champions; six AD/six penetration/six AS passive ranks. Shojin4 stacks/Riftmaker full ramp only if equipped, earned on separate champion before hit; all states logged. Loaded form: owner 100% HP, target 100% HP, Heartsteel earned HP 0, Rod stacks 0, prior champion combat 5s, Gathering Storm minute 30.

Rune reasoning: Aphelios — Infernum Moonlight Vigil cluster: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Basic-ability preparation utility only; it does not reduce this ultimate cooldown or add a cast inside this benchmark. Cut Down: Eligible non-true damage only while victim is above 60% HP; re-evaluate each packet.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.

tradeoffs: Six completed items model a late-game boots swap. Reaching range and surviving preparation become harder; expensive specialized stats sacrifice ordinary pacing and utility.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Moonshot: AP-scaling Calibrum projectile
builds.summary: Investigate high one Calibrum Moonshot projectile output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Calibrum Moonshot projectile output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The Calibrum SpellDamage helper has a level-breakpoint base, level-breakpoint bonus-AD ratio and 1.0 AP. At level 18 its listed breakpoints nominally give 170 + 0.6 bonus AD + 1.0 AP. This experiment treats the projectile as physical and tests armor penetration despite AP scaling; the mark-consuming attack is separate. The generic Q wrapper has no usable weapon formula.
